blocks.x: This tape is being recorded in the back room of the Mardi Gras Lounge, 333 Bourbon Street. The date is January 18, 1951. Present at this time are R.W. Greenwood and Richard B. Allen.
Talk on, you know what you want to tell me?
Okay. I think, Lizzie, the first thing we're interested in finding out is when were you born?
